description: Check the records from add_custom_domain (the ownership TXT and the routing record) and, when both are right, start serving the site on that domain; the HTTPS certificate follows automatically, usually within a minute or two. If it fails, the result names each record to add, change or remove; DNS changes can take a few minutes to propagate. Calling it again on a verified domain is a harmless re-check.

siteName.description: The site the domain was attached to.
